curriculum: The Dutch-taught 180 EC PThU Theology bachelor in Utrecht studies Christian theology, including philosophy, ethics, worldviews and the cultural and public role of religion. Year one is 60 EC, including 12 EC of Theology, Aesthetics and Culture. Year two comprises a 24 EC track, 15 EC of Greek, 15 EC of Hebrew and 6 EC of Personal Development and Worldview. Year three comprises a 30 EC minor, 9 EC of exegesis in the original languages, 6 EC of theology and media and a 15 EC final project. Systematic Theology comes first among four equal-weight tracks in the regulations. The main full-time table illustrates the biblical-language route. The programme also permits a route replacing the language sequences and exegesis with 30 EC of other theology courses and 9 EC of alternative courses including interreligious practice.
progression: The illustration places Greek and Hebrew before exegesis. Both languages are required for the ministry-master exit profile, while a non-language route is allowed for other aims. The 30 EC minor can be taken elsewhere with prior approval. Article 9.2 requires 120 earned EC before thesis preparation. Practical theology introduces church, care and other settings; ministry and spiritual care are possible further trajectories.
